name: SN74LVC1G3157DCKR
title: SPDT analog switch, 1.65 V to 5.5 V
summary: One single-pole double-throw CMOS analog switch for supplies of 1.65 V to 5.5 V. The select input S routes the common terminal A to B1 when low and to B2 when high, breaking one path before making the other. Signals from 0 V to VCC pass either way, analog or digital, through about 6 Ω typical at 4.5 V with 300 MHz bandwidth. It comes in SOT-23, SC-70, SOT-553, two SON packages and a six-ball DSBGA.
key_figures: 6 Ω typ, 7 Ω max at VCC = 4.5 V, VI = 0 V

operation.text: S low closes A to B1; S high closes A to B2. On each change of S the closed channel opens before the other closes, with at least 0.5 ns between, a figure set by design.

The channel conducts both ways and passes analog or digital signals whose peaks reach VCC. Listed uses are signal gating, chopping, modulation and demodulation, and multiplexing for ADC and DAC systems.

Typical ron is highest for signals part-way up the supply at low VCC: at 1.65 V it peaks near 118 Ω with the signal around 1.1 V, while at 4.5 V it stays between about 4 Ω and 8 Ω over the whole signal range.

The recommended range on S is 0 V to 5.5 V. Its thresholds are fractions of VCC: 0.75 × VCC high and 0.25 × VCC low from 1.65 V to 1.95 V, 0.7 × VCC and 0.3 × VCC from 2.3 V to 5.5 V. The input transition rate on S is 20 ns/V maximum from 1.65 V to 2.7 V and 10 ns/V maximum from 3 V to 5.5 V. With S at VCC - 0.6 V the supply current rises by up to 500 µA.
Propagation delay through the closed switch is the RC of its typical on resistance and the load: 0.5 ns typical at VCC = 3 V into 50 pF, and 2 ns to 0.3 ns maximum from 1.8 V to 5 V.
ESD protection exceeds 2000 V HBM, 200 V MM and 1000 V CDM; latch-up exceeds 100 mA to JESD 78 Class II. The on-state switch current has an absolute maximum of ±128 mA.

On DBV, DCK, DRL and DRY a further character after the code names the assembly site. On YZP three leading characters give year, month and sequence, one trailing character names the site, and the pin 1 mark shows the bump alloy (1 for SnPb, a dot for Pb-free).
An AEC-Q100 qualified version is sold as SN74LVC1G3157-Q1.
